A LEGACY OF LEARNING

Strong foundations.
Brighter futures.

Since 1998, a community where every child is encouraged to discover their potential.

Set within the Punjab Police Academy in Phillaur, on the banks of the Sutlej, our five-acre campus brings learning and growing together. We nurture intellectual, creative, emotional and physical development.
